full_judgment: 3. It is the case of the petitioner that the heirs of Nawab Ali Yearor Khan i.e. 3rd party petitioner neither mortgaged their property to the opposite party bank nor stood as guarantor of the loan availed by the defendants to, the Arthawrin Suit. The auction, notice is illegal and void for which petitioner submitted application under Order XXI Rule 58 of the Code of Civil Procedure for getting schedule property released from attachment but the learned Judge of Arthawrin Adalat reject the same holding that 10% decretal amount would he deposited which have not been deposited.
